name: Lightning Bolt
description: Call down lightning to strike an enemy.

name: Chain Lightning
description: Lightning that jumps between multiple enemies.

name: Flame Shock
description: Burn an enemy with fire that persists over time.

name: Earth Shock
description: Shock an enemy with the force of the earth.

name: Lava Burst
description: Hurl molten lava at an enemy, always crits on Flame Shocked targets.

name: Healing Wave
description: Channel the spirits to heal an ally.

name: Chain Heal
description: Healing that bounces between injured allies.

name: Healing Rain
description: Create an area of healing rain.

name: Totemic Recall
description: Recall all totems, refunding some mana.

name: Healing Stream Totem
description: Place a totem that heals nearby allies.

name: Searing Totem
description: Place a totem that attacks nearby enemies with fire.

name: Earthbind Totem
description: Place a totem that slows nearby enemies.

name: Grounding Totem
description: Place a totem that absorbs enemy spells.

name: Spirit Link Totem
description: Place a totem that redistributes health among allies.

name: Hex
description: Transform an enemy into a frog.

name: Wind Shear
description: Interrupt an enemy spellcast with wind.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Blast enemies away with a burst of lightning.

name: Feral Spirit
description: Summon spirit wolves to fight alongside you.

name: Ascendance
description: Transform into an elemental ascendant.

name: Bloodlust
description: Drastically increase haste for all party members.
